manifest.name: HANDS JARVIS Silver
manifest.summary: Metallic JARVIS desktop companion with HANDS tool shortcuts, live render progress, privacy controls, docking, and review-first command handoff.
manifest.author: HANDS for GPT; derived from Roamies by KenKaiii

instructions: HANDS JARVIS Silver v0.2.0 is a SOURCE-PACKAGED, SEPARATE modified Roamies companion under AGPL-3.0. It includes an Apple-style chrome/silver animated orb, double-click to open HANDS, a HANDS control panel listing local HANDS modules, read-only live Visual Studio rendering progress, copy-and-open HANDS prompt handoff, quick privacy controls, edge docking, and low-power panel animation. The source patch and opt-in installer are at https://github.com/HANDSforGPT/hands-tools/tree/hands-jarvis-silver/runtime/hands-jarvis-silver . The upstream project is https://github.com/KenKaiii/Roamies ; original commit bd1e411f9cf9c9f54aaa3e98d265d4c33b38ccc5; AGPL-3.0. The HANDS Tool Store module installs instructions ONLY, never a binary or new MCP command. The companion is NOT yet directly connected to HANDS command execution, HANDS Brain memory, HANDS True Voice speech, or auto-fullscreen detection. For source installation, first inspect README, NOTICE and silver.patch. Run a locally authorized HANDS terminal command: 'bash runtime/hands-jarvis-silver/launcher.sh --doctor' to inspect prerequisites, '--install' to clone the pinned upstream and apply the silver patch to an EMPTY folder, '--build' after installing Node.js 22+, Rust/Cargo, Tauri CLI v2, Xcode command line tools and npm ci in showcase/tauri/sidecar, then '--launch' to open the signed/unsigned local application. Set HANDS_JARVIS_HOME to external SSD to avoid filling the internal disk. This user's prepared source is /Volumes/EMTEC X200E/HANDS Projects/JARVIS Silver/Source. DO NOT re-run --install over it. The HANDS panel's 'Copy + open' operation copies text and opens HANDS; the user must paste, inspect and submit there. Never claim a command executed on HANDS based on handoff alone. Real native HANDS actions retain all required permissions/approvals. Do not send account credentials or keys into the companion, or enable microphone/screen permissions automatically. The original updater is disabled for this derivative. A GitHub Actions workflow prepares an unsigned macOS app ZIP only if the build succeeds. Corresponding source, original AGPL-3.0 license and third-party notices must accompany redistributed modified binaries.

recipes.title: Inspect and launch the HANDS controller

steps.instruction: Use HANDS Tools to install this declarative module, inspect README and AGPL attribution first.
Using the HANDS terminal after approval, run the launcher with --doctor to verify a built app is present.
If compiled, use --launch. In the silver companion open the HANDS sidebar tab; double-click the orb to launch HANDS.
Open the HANDS JARVIS Silver control panel's HANDS tab. This uses read-only Visual Studio status; do not invent progress or assume the engine is running.
Select a project, view its stage and QA counts, and open the main HANDS app for actions requiring approval.
Choose an installed HANDS module or type a request in the HANDS tab. The panel copies the request to the clipboard and opens HANDS.
The user pastes and submits the request in HANDS. Only HANDS executes with its normal permissions and confirmations.
If needed and approved, install the pinned source in an empty external SSD directory and install Rust, Node and Tauri dependencies. Do not overwrite existing work.
Build and test the companion; check the GitHub Actions artifact before calling it downloadable. Preserve AGPL source and attributions.
